title: Lemma 6 (total displacement vs. inversions): justification incomplete

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body: Lemma 6 states $\sum_{i=1}^n|\pi(i)-i|\le 2\,\inv(\pi)$. The statement is TRUE (verified by brute-force enumeration for all $\pi\in S_n$, $n\le7$). However the written proof asserts 'each adjacent transposition changes $\sum|\cdot|$ by at most $2$ and $\inv$ by $\pm1$, and $\inv(\pi)$ is the minimal number of adjacent transpositions needed' without exhibiting a sorting sequence of length exactly $\inv(\pi)$ in which EVERY swap is inv-DECREASING. The clean fix: run bubble sort, repeatedly swapping any adjacent inversion; this performs exactly $\inv(\pi)$ swaps, each reducing $\inv$ by exactly $1$ and reducing $T:=\sum_i|\pi(i)-i|$ by at most $2$. Telescoping gives $T\le 2\,\inv(\pi)$. One added sentence closes this. Low priority.
